title: RTCP: Use dissector table for RTCP-RTPFB payload types
description:
Refactor RTCP dissector to use rtcp_rtpfb_dissector_table for handling
dissection of different RTPFB payload values. In legacy this was done
with switch statement.

Currently supported RTPFB payload types:
Generic NACK (1)
Temporary Maximum Media Stream Bit Rate Request (3)
Temporary Maximum Media Stream Bit Rate Request (4)
RTCP Rapid Resynchronisation Request (5)
RTP Congestion Control Feedback (11)
Transport-wide Congestion Control (15)

Other payload types are not fully supported.

After this change there should be no difference in dissection of
payload types (in comparison with legacy).

TESTING: I don't have example pcap files of supported payload types to
try this change but I generated them with randpkt program and compared
results with legacy.
